dataset: UCI Online Retail II — product pricing subset
selection: All source transactions for the 25 most frequently appearing StockCodes in the first 50,000 source rows; original values and source order retained across both workbook sheets.
notes: Attribution: Daqing Chen / UCI. Replaces the originally proposed research-restricted Dominick's source. This is an observational purchase table, not a randomized pricing experiment or a complete product-availability log. Prices are observed; margins/costs and unobserved demand require explicit assumptions. Product selection uses the initial source rows and does not inspect future price outcomes.
